sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Maypop is a rhizomatous perennial vine native to the south-eastern United States. It climbs by tendrils and can spread along roadsides and open ground.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: The deciduous leaves are three-lobed. The white flowers with a pink-purple corona are about 2.5–7.6 cm across. The ripe yellow berry is about 2.5–7.6 cm long.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: NC State Extension lists the ripe berry as edible. That source does not recommend eating the leaves, roots or other parts.
